historical_commentary.text: A hands-on tutorial for a specific interactive UI feature (drag-and-drop) of the now-discontinued 4DAF Data Grid; drag-and-drop as a UX pattern remains relevant, but the exact API and object model described no longer exist in any supported 4D product.
related_updates: 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF), including this Data Grid generation, has been fully discontinued

Modern drag-and-drop web interactions in 4D applications are implemented via standard JavaScript/HTML5 drag-and-drop APIs or through Qodly Studio's web components (2021+), not the 4DAF Data Grid object
